# Summary

What changed?

# Why

# Validation

What was run or checked?

# Checklist

- [ ] Change is focused and does not contain unrelated refactoring
- [ ] Relevant tests were added or updated
- [ ] Relevant tests pass
- [ ] Public documentation reflects user-visible behaviour
- [ ] No secrets, local files, or generated build artifacts are included
- [ ] Performance claims, if any, include reproducible measurements
